# `assets/AssetResolver.js`

> **Source:** `engine/assets/AssetResolver.js`

engine/assets/AssetResolver.js — virtual-path resolution + backup repair (spec §3, rule 5). Files move, browser permissions expire, cloud mirrors lag. The resolver maps a scheme:// path to a concrete backend and, when reading a registered asset, tries the primary then each backup, verifying by content hash. If a backup matches the expected hash it repairs the primary; if a candidate's hash differs it is flagged a conflict (never silently accepted).

## Classes

### `class AssetResolver`

A backend is { async read(path) -> Uint8Array|null, async write?(path, bytes) }. Schemes without a registered backend simply fail to resolve (caller falls back).

| Method | Signature | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `constructor` | `constructor(opts = {})` |  |
| `registerBackend` | `registerBackend(scheme, backend)` |  |
| `hasBackend` | `hasBackend(scheme)` |  |
| `read` | `async read(vpath)` | Read raw bytes for a single virtual path, or null if unavailable. |
| `write` | `async write(vpath, bytes)` |  |
| `resolveAsset` | `async resolveAsset(record)` | Resolve a registered asset's bytes with backup fallback + hash repair. |

## Functions

### `backendFromCache(cache)`

Adapt an AssetCache instance to a resolver backend (cache:// scheme).

### `makeFetchBackend(base)`

A read-only backend that fetches relative to a base URL (asset://, cloud://).

### `makeMemoryBackend(initial = {})`

A simple in-memory backend (temp:// drag-drop, user:// session mounts).
